## Source

The [COVID-19 Effect on Liver Cancer Prediction Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/fedesoriano/covid19-effect-on-liver-cancer-prediction-dataset) (Kaggle): 450 patients with HCC or ICC referred to the Newcastle-upon-Tyne NHS Foundation Trust between March 2019 and February 2021.
